Delete the old version first, then ingest the new one
Keep both versions active permanently
Ingest the new version fully, then atomically flip is_active in one transaction

Tombstone first (is_active = 0), async purge after a grace period, keep the tombstone row for compliance
Never delete anything

Keep using the old model forever
